_comment: Localidades das páginas locais de Déménagement, Débarras e Nettoyage (/demenagement-<slug>, /debarras-<slug>, /nettoyage-fin-de-bail-<slug>). Só geografia real e afirmações já feitas no site (zona de atuação: Genève, Vaud, Fribourg, Valais). Genève, Lausanne e Vaud têm página de mudança própria (pages/locations); as outras são geradas. Título e descrição de cada rota ficam em seoRoutes.json; rotas, sitemap e vercel.json são gerados a partir desta lista: node scripts/sync-localities.mjs

localities.name: Genève
localities.intro: De la Vieille-Ville aux communes du canton, nous intervenons dans tout Genève.

notes.title: Stationnement à Genève
notes.text: L'autorisation se demande à la police du stationnement et les panneaux officiels se posent 48 h avant. Sur demande, nous nous en chargeons pour vous.

notes.title: Vieille-Ville et immeubles anciens
notes.text: Ruelles pavées, accès piétons et escaliers étroits : nos équipes protègent sols, murs et cages d'escalier avant de commencer.

en.name: Geneva
en.intro: From the Old Town to every municipality in the canton, we work throughout Geneva.

notes.title: Parking in Geneva
notes.text: The permit is issued by the parking police and the official signs go up 48 h before. On request, we take care of it for you.

notes.title: Old Town and older buildings
notes.text: Cobbled lanes, pedestrian-only access and narrow staircases: our teams protect floors, walls and stairwells before they start.
